Don't say you've eat pho until you try this one.
Sep 2018 • Couples
THIS IS A KEEPER.
We travel just for this, and it didn't disappointed us. we don't eat beef, and the time we arrived was out of chicken and pork, owner was really kind to offer one bowl of pho with eggs. Never thought pho can be this good, especially without meat but just egg. 
Price was very cheap; highly recommend you to come the first or the second day here in Nha Trang, I guarantee you will come back and want to make sure you save more time for the great food. 

【Warning】No AC, at the corner on the street, very hot, but the food was above and beyond any words.
